title: Erdos #1002 OQ-01: Proving Cauchy CDF and Periodic Sum Axioms

problemStatement.plain: Eliminate two axioms from Erdős #1002: prove the Cauchy CDF is a valid distribution function and prove periodicity of the inner sum for rational arguments.
whyMatters: Reduces axiom count from 7 to 5 in the parent formalization
Both are standard results provable from Mathlib

proven: cauchy_is_distribution: Cauchy CDF g(c) = (1/π)arctan(ρc) + 1/2 is monotone with g(-∞)=0, g(+∞)=1
innerSum_periodic_rational: S(p/q, n+q) = S(p/q, n) + S(p/q, q) via fractional part periodicity
open: Weyl equidistribution (deep result, not yet in Mathlib in usable form)
